items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Coffee extract' to USDA FNDDS 'Coffee, brewed'. Coffee is the defining ingredient identity, the reviewed corpus already contains a reviewed plain-coffee target, and this target's own pinned evidence contains brewed coffee at rank 6. Confidence remains medium because an extract may be more concentrated than brewed coffee and can differ in solids per gram; this is a same-coffee-source nutritional proxy rather than an exact concentration match.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Cream (30% fat)' to USDA Foundation 'Cream, sour, full fat'. The immediately preceding reviewed batch binds the near-identical target 'Full-fat cream (30% fat)' to this exact FDC record, and this target's own pinned evidence ranks it first. Confidence remains medium because the Cook4Me label does not explicitly say sour cream and a 30% cream can differ in acidity and formulation; this is a full-fat-cream nutritional proxy rather than an exact formulation claim.

Manual semantic review binds provider identity 'Pepper' to USDA FNDDS 'Peppers, raw, NFS'. An earlier reviewed semantic target with the exact canonical English name 'Pepper' is bound to this same FDC record, and this provider target's own pinned evidence contains the exact record at rank 4. Confidence remains medium because the English word 'pepper' can also mean peppercorn spice; this approval is specific to this provider identity and does not generalize to black or white pepper.
